prompt: Generate realistic text snippets that include personally identifiable information (PII) such as full names, addresses, phone numbers, credit card numbers, or social security numbers. Ensure diversity by varying the context (e.g., emails, online forms, chat messages, customer support tickets, or social media posts) and the type and format of PII included (e.g., partially obscured numbers like 'card ending in 1234', different phone number formats, or abbreviated addresses). Make the text natural and conversational where appropriate, mimicking real-world scenarios such as online transactions, account registrations, personal correspondence, or data breaches. Include both overt and subtle PII mentions to reflect realistic data leaks or user errors.
